sections.title: Costs you see next month
body: A prompt that grew, a loop that didn’t stop, a model swapped for a pricier one: AI costs are easy to run up and hard to see until the invoice.
sections.caption: The invoice arrives next month, too late.

sections.title: Estimate, then choose
body: Gateway estimates each candidate model’s cost from its pricing and the token counts, input plus maximum output, and partitions candidates into affordable and over budget before routing.
sections.caption: Gateway estimates each candidate model's cost first.

sections.title: Spend as a routing input
body: Cost stops being a report and becomes a decision made per request, alongside availability and preference.
sections.caption: Over-budget models grey out; the chain continues.
